reason: Independent FP32 train-mode sparse-backbone forwards show small numerical variation despite restored model/BN/RNG. Native and frozen-query downstream paths become bitwise identical when given the same backbone output.

implementation.step1: Each source uses one actual native full-network autograd graph, with the previously frozen labels. Derive total, q0-width and count-matched-random-width gradients from that graph; form the seven gradient-scope conditions. Each independent branch still starts from the original parameters, optimizer moments, and that same forward's BN/RNG state.
implementation.steps2_to5: Recompute full backbone and backward for every branch and update; no cached or detached features used for optimization.
implementation.equivalence: Use a shared-backbone zero-update check to verify downstream outputs exactly; independent-forward numerical differences remain visible in receipts and are not selected by repeated retries.
implementation.scientific_scope: Unchanged seven conditions, eight source batches, two folds, both post-update steps1/5, fixed loss denominator, actual Adam moments, count and step-norm controls.
implementation.initial_gradient_scope: R0 total; RW total minus q0-width; RW-local retains q0-width only in final width layer; random total minus fixed matched-count subset. A/D/Q final-layer gradients must be unchanged.
